Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
--
-- Invalid date is trapped by on_error. On_error routine will Popup an error screen, if you try
-- to display another error using show_error. On_error is invoked the first time that the contents 
-- of the date field is referenced, so this section of code just checks for date format errors using the
-- on_error checks.
--
 begin
 :GLOBAL.date := to_char(:vequip_parms.eff_date, 'MM-DD-YY');
 exception
 when others then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end;
--
 if (:vequip_parms.eff_date is null) then
 show_error ('5002');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 
 chp_sysdate := lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_lcl_time(:GLOBAL.tz_enabled, :GLOBAL.tz_offset, SYSDATE); -- IM 402
 
 if (:SYSTEM.record_status in ('NEW', 'INSERT', 'CHANGED')) then
 if (:vequip_parms.eff_date < trunc(chp_sysdate)) then -- IM 402
 show_error ('5003');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 if (:vequip_parms.eff_date > nvl (:vequip_parms.term_date, :vequip_parms.eff_date)) then
 show_error ('1316');
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: SEQUENCE_VEQUIP_PARMS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE sequence_vequip_parms IS
BEGIN
 :global.current_record := :system.cursor_record;
 :global.current_field := :system.cursor_field;
 :global.max_ref := 0;
 go_record ('1');
 while (:vequip_parms.equip_type is not null ) loop
 if (nvl(:vequip_parms.arrange_by,0) != (:system.cursor_record*100)) then
 :vequip_parms.arrange_by := (:system.cursor_record * 100);
 end if;
 if (:vequip_parms.ref_number >= :global.max_ref) then
 :global.max_ref := :vequip_parms.ref_number+1;
 end if;
 next_record;
 end loop;
 go_record (:global.current_record);
 if (:vequip_parms.ref_number is null) then
 :vequip_parms.ref_number := :global.max_ref;
 end if;
 GO_ITEM (:global.current_field);
END;
